purpose: Exploratory matched comparison of downloaded Qwen3.5-4B Q4_K_M and already-trained Nemotron Q4, not a LoRA before/after or fresh holdout.
suite: 32 previously evaluated natural math, 20 plain, 16 blocked tool-selection, 4 original smoke, 8 known correct-expression diagnostic prompts; identical order in each run.
runtime: actual shared GameTerm coordinator/provider/harness/calculator, captured 35 tools, model-native chat template, fake blocked OS
token_bans: derive independently per model from live /tokenize using native dash_free probe_strings + singleton-only banned_from rule; save all probe responses and native source hash
scoring: Manual coding-agent final-answer review; accept correct answers in prose; no gold-number-occurrence matching. Count incomplete/truncated/unrelated math actions as failures. Selection evaluates requests not external action execution. Correct expressions, numeric receipts and final fidelity checked separately.
statistics: Each repetition compared on paired question IDs; do not pool repeats as independent questions. Report item-difference SD/SE, paired bootstrap CI, exact McNemar, cross-repeat disagreements.
limits: Previously selected/evaluated questions, not population/adoption proof
Community Qwen quantization; exact Mac file identity unverified
Captured character configuration, not exact current Air environment
One training checkpoint per model; cannot isolate pretraining, architecture or training recipe causes
decision: Diagnostic only; no further training/deployment automatically triggered.
